cfc.title: Call for Communications
cfc.subtitle: Submit your research to the TUNCIS 2026 Doctoral Consortium and share your work with researchers from Tunisia and Europe.
cfc.topicsPending: Detailed topics of interest will be published by the organizing committee. Submissions should relate to Artificial Intelligence, from research to industrial deployment.
cfc.guidelinesText: Submissions should be original, unpublished work relevant to the topics above. Doctoral Consortium submissions should include a summary of the research problem, methodology, and current progress.
